name: What is involved in the window trim repair process?

mainEntity.name: What is involved in the window trim repair process?

acceptedAnswer.text: Window trim repair typically involves several steps. First, the damaged trim is assessed to determine the extent of the issue. Depending on the damage, this may include removing old caulk and paint, repairing minor imperfections with wood filler, or replacing severely rotted sections with new material. The new or repaired trim is then sanded, primed, and painted or stained to match your home's exterior, ensuring a seamless and durable finish.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves assessing damage, removing old materials, repairing or replacing trim sections, and then priming and painting.
